60033 [see DMG memo 02/25] “Severely disabled person” means a person for whom


1. AA1 or


2. the care component of DLA at the highest or middle rate or pension age disability
payment2 or

3. CAA payable as


       3.1 an increase of IIDB3 or


       3.2 an increase of an old scheme allowance4 or


       3.3 an increase of WC5 or


       3.4 a WDisP6 or


4. the daily living component of PIP at the standard or enhanced rate 7 or

5. AFIP8 or


6. the care component of CDP at the highest or middle rate 9 or


7. the care component of ADP at the standard or enhanced rate10 or


8. an equivalent benefit from an EU member state11 or


is payable provided that it is payable at a weekly rate of at least that specified in legislation 12.


Note: The meaning of WDisP is prescribed13.
